D/ IMP CAESAR [VESPAS]IANVS AVG TR P ; R/ COS ITER TR POT

A Roman silver coin: denarius of Vespasian, dated AD70. RIC no. 379-380. Aequitas reverse COS ITER TR POT. Mint of Lugdunum (Lyons). Obverse: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP CAESAR [VESPAS]IANVS AVG TR P. Reverse: Aequitas draped, standing left, Holding scales in right hand and rod (pertica) in left. Reverse inscription: COS ITER TR POT.
